# Bid the spring, the door, and the drive — not a lump sum.

> Price a garage door replacement or broken-spring service from parts, shop labor, and travel — not a lump-sum guess. See when a $189 spring special loses money on the drive.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
